info.title: PolicyWell API
info.description: REST endpoints for PolicyWell - the Agentic Operating System for the Insurance & Financial Services Industry. Personal and commercial policy, risk, underwriting, and distribution intelligence. Status markers: Live, Preview, Planned, Enterprise. Planned/Preview endpoints are contracts, not operational production APIs.
